articles.title: Massachusetts falls out of top 10 in best state rankings by U.S. News & World Report
articles.description:
Massachusetts has fallen to No. 11 in U.S. News & World Report's 2026 Best States rankings, dropping two spots from last year.

The post Massachusetts falls out of top 10 in best state rankings by U.S. News & World Report appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Massachusetts dropped to No. 11 in U.S. News & World Report's 2026 Best States rankings.
The state fell two spots from its previous ranking in 2025.
Residents may face implications in funding and resources due to the lower ranking.

articles.title: Massachusetts loses two IHOP restaurants
articles.description:
The all-day breakfast chain has closed its Cambridge and Hyannis locations, though about 20 restaurants remain open statewide.

The post Massachusetts loses two IHOP restaurants appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: IHOP closes locations in Cambridge and Hyannis, reducing dining options for residents.
Approximately 20 IHOP restaurants remain operational across Massachusetts.
Local job losses expected as two restaurants shut down in the state.

articles.title: Court agrees Wu did not discriminate against North End restaurants, but may have illegally taxed them
articles.description:
Thursday’s decision marks the latest in a longstanding feud over pandemic-era outdoor dining regulations in the North End.

The post Court agrees Wu did not discriminate against North End restaurants, but may have illegally taxed them appeared first on Boston.com.
summary: Court ruled Wu did not discriminate against North End restaurants regarding outdoor dining regulations.
Decision highlights potential illegal taxation on these restaurants during the pandemic.
Local businesses may seek refunds or adjustments due to the court's findings.
